question_source.pool_status: Existing supplied candidate pool/order frozen for a proposed run; team-common currently freezes IDs, not this candidate pool or prompt contract. Match the comparison partner before claiming a router-only comparison.

executors.dtype: From common models.toml: bf16, AWQ only70B/72B
executors.sampling_status: Proposed deterministic K1 router-control protocol, not an upstream common mandate or original AgentTTS sampling recipe. Must match LLM-router comparator/cache.
executors.evidence_policy: Use only actual selected retrieval output; never gold evidence. Pool cap, passage char limit and context budget must be frozen with the shared generation/cache contract; no silent truncation.

router.architecture: Direct two-stage, three-way model selection at each stage
router.features: Training-only TF-IDF vocabulary and numerical text features; trees use appropriate numeric features. QA training uses all3 branches grouped by question.
router.labels: Proposed: cheapest correct QA model per branch, cheapest retrieval+QA success branch for retrieval; mask all-incorrect groups rather than invent a correct target. Train only on train_extra outcomes.
router.selection: Training CV within question groups for fit settings; validation for operating points; freeze before test. No artificial epoch count for non-iterative classifiers. Iterative additions must log common train/val loss and keep best val epoch.
router.grpo: Separate later extension, not part of this supervised K1 baseline.

generation_plan.note: Full offline9-cell grid supports labels, fixed-route controls and exact replay. Deployment charges only executed calls, not all offline counterfactual cells. Must re-generate with common pinned executors; old Qwen1.5B/7B labels are not substitutes.

controls: accuracy-cost frontier / cheapest validation >=95% of current strongest validation accuracy

cost.basis: Actual per-question prompt and generated tokens, nominal params from common menu; include every executed model call. Shared prompt once for sampling extensions.
report: relative cost versus strongest run on the same questions
cost.router_overhead: Time feature extraction and decision; no fictional LLM size for a classical router. FLOP proxy excludes CPU router work, which must be disclosed.

outputs.test_status: Historical test content previously examined; new routers must not fit it. This project cannot recover a never-observed confirmation set.

comparison.pure_router: Share exact executor caches, prompts, candidate pools, decoding, copies, split and cost/score scripts with LLM-router comparator.
comparison.full_system: If generation/retrieval differs, label as whole-system comparison, not an isolated router comparison.
comparison.other_track_results: No aligned external results imported yet.
